title: Sri Ganesha – Tulsi Story: From Attraction and Rejection Toward Transformation of Consciousness

sections.title: Video
content: In this Jnanodayam program the topic of Sri Ganesha–Tulsi was examined from a spiritual perspective. Aspects that came up included knowing the inner meaning in the stories, observing emotions such as attraction and rejection, and moving toward the evolution of consciousness through stillness. The available captions indicate that the discussion proceeded in the direction that the understanding gained through the stories is more important than the different narrative forms.
